summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block, with the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias), exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py via a parenthesized import, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with two tests (binary 2D and empty class). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions, so the tests are unverified. Hand-checked the batch-of-two acceptance numbers (TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss about 0.333). Choices made: the target is squeezed with target[:, 0] when it has the input's rank; the distance matrix keeps its dtype and is only moved to the probability device.
